acceptanceCriteria: affected emits no Go-provider unknown for a repository without Go units, with a test.
body: Found during the Beamfall Corvint setup rollout A (2026-10-20, corvint 1.0.0-rc.3 build 676). In oscillux (Rust) and beamfall-linux (C), affected lists `NO_ADVISORY_GO_COMMAND: provider.go.state is EMPTY_SELECTION` as an unknown. Expected: no Go-provider unknown when the repository has no Go units.
title: affected reports NO_ADVISORY_GO_COMMAND (provider.go.state EMPTY_SELECTION) as an unknown in repos with no Go units
